purpose: Describe and validate the authoritative structural specification for the Community admissibility constraint while preserving its historical semantic variant, opaque scientific values, source identity, and unresolved reservations without scientific execution.

required.statement: Accept only feature identity TLC-FC-02-COMMUNITY-001 and the supported operations describe_feature_specification, validate_feature_specification, and request_scientific_execution.
Preserve source object TLC-SO-COMMUNITY-008 exactly and preserve all required source artifact references, including the supplemental semantic IR as non-canonical evidence.
Preserve the authoritative ordered set of 29 Community unresolved identifiers exactly, without addition, omission, duplication, or resolution.
Transport measure, coherence, actor-domain, and result handles as opaque values without interpretation.
Return deterministic structural metadata for describe and validate operations, and a stable structured rejection for scientific execution.

forbidden.statement: Do not evaluate, compare, infer, or assign scientific semantics to opaque values.
Do not promote the supplemental semantic IR to canonical status or replace the source IR.
Do not invent a measure, measurable space, coherence function, comparator, actor domain, result type, equation, dimension, or numerical method.
Do not expose a successful partial result after validation or preservation failure.

deferred.statement: Scientific evaluation remains unavailable until the preserved scientific reservations are resolved by authoritative upstream work.
Storage, ownership, allocation, layout, concurrency, and error transport mechanisms remain implementation-defined unless they affect observable behavior.

operations.purpose: Validate or describe the final structural specification, or reject a request for unavailable scientific execution.

inputs.name: request
inputs.semantic_role: Community specification request with optional opaque scientific handles

fields.name: supplied_source_references
fields.semantic_role: references to validate against authoritative provenance

constraints.statement: Opaque values may be absent or empty, but any supplied value must remain observationally unchanged.

fields.name: status
fields.semantic_role: structural completion and preserved-unresolved scientific status

constraints.statement: The supplemental semantic IR remains visibly supplemental and non-canonical.
The unresolved collection equals TLC-UT-COMMUNITY-001 through TLC-UT-COMMUNITY-029 in authoritative lexical order.

preconditions.statement: The feature identity and requested operation are supported.
Every required contract, source IR, supplemental IR, test plan, finalized IR, algorithm, oracle, and scientific source reference is present and mutually consistent.
No supplied scientific payload requires interpretation.

postconditions.statement: A successful describe or validate operation returns all required fields with exact source identity, exact unresolved preservation, and unchanged opaque handles.
A scientific execution request returns COMMUNITY_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTION_REQUEST and no partial result.
No source artifact or scientific state is mutated.

invariants.statement: Source object identity and order are invariant.
The exact 29-item unresolved set is invariant.
Opaque scientific values remain uninterpreted and unchanged.
The historical semantic variant remains supplemental evidence only.

prescription_basis: Only validation and preservation before observable success or rejection are normative; the upstream total step order is an indicative strategy.

error_contract.condition: The request or any referenced artifact does not identify TLC-FC-02-COMMUNITY-001 exactly.
A required source, contract, IR, test plan, finalized IR, algorithm, oracle, or supplemental IR reference is absent.
Required provenance is absent or inconsistent.
The authoritative unresolved collection is changed, omitted, duplicated, reordered, or marked resolved.
An opaque scientific value is evaluated, compared, typed, or otherwise interpreted.
An operation requires scientific semantics that remain unresolved.
Scientific execution is requested from this structural-only package.

implementation_modes.statement: Implement deterministic describe and validation behavior with exact preservation and stable errors.
Do not execute or complete unresolved scientific semantics.
Internal architecture and validation decomposition are free when every observable obligation is preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Absence of scientific definition never becomes a default value or inferred behavior.
Source, unresolved, and opaque identities remain lossless and traceable.

notes: Scientific correctness is not asserted; structural preservation and rejection behavior are normative.
